    KIVIK Sofa frame605.193.63KIVIK Sofa frame605.193.63KIVIK Sofa frame605.193.63

Enjoy the super comfy KIVIK sofa with deep seat cushions made of pocket springs, high resilience foam and polyester fibers – adding both firm support and relaxing softness.

The size and depth of the sofa make it perfect for a nice nap or when the whole family is gathered. There is room for everyone and even extra seating on the wide armrests.

The wide armrests have room for everything from your mobile phone to a bowl of movie snacks and very comfortable to lay your head on when you lie down on the sofa for a rest.

KIVIK sofa has a strong personality and a clear design language, while the options mean that you can easily match it with your home decor.

It is easy to combine the sofa with one or more chaise lounges thanks to the removable armrests.

Pocket springs are a durable solution that makes the sofa retain both its shape and comfort for many years.

This cover is made of dope-dyed Gunnared fabric in polyester. It is a durable fabric with a wool-like feel, a warm look and a two-toned mélange effect.

The cover is easy to keep clean since it can be machine washed and is easy to take off and put on again.

We have many removable covers and functions to choose from, so you can always find something that suits you. Use the planning tool to find the combination and cover that are perfect for you.

10-year limited warranty. Read about the terms in the limited warranty brochure.

  • This cover’s ability to resist abrasion has been tested to handle 55,000 cycles. 15,000 cycles or more is suitable for furniture used every day at home. Over 30,000 cycles means a good ability to resist abrasion.This seating furniture is tested and complies with relevant strength and durability standards. The tests simulate typical usage of the product and are based on use by persons weighing up to 242 lbs.The cover has a lightfastness level of 5 (the ability to resist color fading) on a scale of 1 to 8. According to industry standards, a lightfastness level of 4 or higher is suitable for home use.

Reviews

Firm, but comfortableMaryOur Kivik sofa is over a year old now and the fabric and cushions barely show any wear after daily use. As stated in the description this is a *firm* loveseat. I like that I can put a pillow at the end for my head, and my legs can rest on the opposite arm without it being at an uncomfortable angle. The corduroy fabric is very soft. It took time to get the fabric right during assembly, but an iron helped. A great sofa if you prefer firm cushioning.5
Very uncomfortable AbdullahHorrible and very uncomfortable. I’m thinking to throw it away 1
satisfied with sofaLeslieAssembly was reasonable. I like the look of the sofa and it is comfortable to sit on. We also had an overnight guest who said it was comfortable for sleeping. I gave it 4 instead of 5 stars because the material is a bit scratchy, which I didn't expect based on the sample in the store. Knowing this I would have selected a different material/color.4
Easy Assembly Great LookRonThe KIVIK sofa was easy enough to assemble using only twelve nut and bolts, and is extremely sturdy. A sofa needing assembly was required due to a narrow stairway and door to my finished basement. There is no way to get a full sized sofa or loveseat down the stairwell, and 90 degree turn through a 30” door. Unboxing in the living room and carrying the four components down was the only option. After unboxing the covers, I did iron out the visible fold lines, which were easy enough to iron, just takes a little time. I recommend when putting on the arm covers to start with the front of the arm and working your way to the side and back. The covers will be taught, so have patience when working on making straight seam lines. The sofa and cushion covers fit tight giving the sofa a quality finished look. As others have mentioned the cushions are firm, but after a couple of weeks can tell they are getting just a bit softer to the seat. Extremely happy with the sofa and bought the ottoman too.5
Uncomfortable and ugly OwenTotally uncomfortable the cushions are to thick they force you to sit straight up leaning forward. My back hurts sitting on it. Also it is squat and ugly sitting low on the floor. $1300 after having Taskrabbit assemble it and I still don’t have a couch. 1
Comfortable sofa but the fabric cover pilled terriblyMeganI’ve just used this sofa under normal circumstances and the fabric has pilled terribly, especially on the seats. I have one of the cotton/polyester blends so I’m not sure if that has something to do with it. I’m pretty disappointed because I’ve had the couch for less than a year and I feel embarassed by its appearance 3
worst sofa everJacobsofa is so small, can barely lay down on it without falling off the side.1
Plastic, plastic, and more plasticJohnTerrible quality, the entire thing besides the wood frame and metall spring is plastic. the sofa covers used to be better but now, quality has gotten worse. "fabric" used to be little better than stuff you find somewhere like target. NOW, its equal to target quality but just IKEA prices. terrible all around, had this sofa 5 years ago and the fabric was stitched fully, not just 1 side and it was much more high quality fabric (even though its all plastic really). TERRIBLE, will think twice now before buying IKEA priced things for Target quality.1
Overall very happyJoStill a great value if you want a deep seat sofa. The tallmyra green is very classy and unique... a soft, silvery, sage green. It's a bit less saturated than the photos, in a good way. This is my second Kivik, first one was the previous generation. I much prefer these updated, firmer cushions. IMO it's a novice mistake to think you want a couch with no support that you sink into. A firm cushion with support is much better long term for comfort and longevity. I did have some frustrating issues getting the arms to attach because the specs were clearly off, i.e. it wasn't made right. I've had this issue with other recent furniture purchases from IKEA (which I NEVER had previously in 20+ years of shopping at IKEA). It's not a good look so IKEA I suggest you check on your manufacturers...4
Hard as rockEkaterinaIt’s completely different filling from what I saw in a store. They use nice and soft sofa in the show room and one I have home I barely can use. I’ll need to change seats inserts for extra money3
Worst Ikea Purchase I've MadeLindsayWe purchased the Kivi sofa and loveseat for a living room that gets very little use. We had the sofa for about 6-7 months and had company about 4 times. The UPGRADED fabric (anthracite) was pilling so badly that I reached out to customer service, and sent a ton of photos. I've never had that happen to Ikea fabric. They basically told me there was nothing they could do, because fabric isnt covered under warranty. So basically I spent close to 2k on sofas that look horrible. I will never buy an Ikea sofa or recommend them again. Customer service in this case was horrible to work with.2
Great SofaNicholasI absolutely love this sofa for multiple reasons, and here are some: Firm, but comfortable. Good price, well-made. Easy assembly. Covers are interchangeable and washable. I am very happy that I chose this sofa. It will be used for many years to come. I also loved being able to have it shipped to any room inside my home, because that was a big help. The delivery crew was great, and they had a good automated text system letting me know the timeframe, and even one saying they were close. Overall a 5-star experience from IKEA and the delivery crew.5
Different from what it is in the showroomShokoAs everyone reviewed, the product is way harder than what is displayed in the showroom. I even thought that I somehow picked up something different. I revisited the store with my family and it appears the product name is the same. My family sat on the couch displayed and they have the same feeling. If you are in love with the product in the showroom, that is not what you will be receiving. I love the appearance and looks of nice in the room but no one is sitting on it. 2
Too hardJuan SebastianHas a good design and its wide but cushions are too hard even after using it for 6 months. It also looks a bit messy because you need to put all the fabrics in including the arms and it is difficult to get 100% alignment.2
Many of the features are cheaper qualitySandyFirst off, the fabric is cheap and doesn't match my loveseat of the "same" fabric. Second, you can no longer flip the cushions one side is cheap grey sheeting (the cushions slide forward much more easily). That WAS one of the best features of the Kivik over their other sofas and was a factor in my decision. The zipper seams aren't flat anymore. I have purchased several over the years for different properties, they used to wear like iron. Disappointed and after 3 ottomans, 4 loveseats and 3 sofas, I'll be going elsewhere next time.2
Good size family sofa for apartmentJerelI live in an apartment at this sofa fits just fine. I can add the chase to it if I wanted to. It's a bit firm at first then softens up nicely after about a month. 3 people fit comfortably and loosely. 4 people can fit if wanted. It's fairly easy to build and can change the color anytime with covers5
Too hard JackMuch like the other reviews, I thought the Kivik in the showroom was soft and comfortable but after setting it up in my apartment it is more comparable to a park bench. Really difficult to watch a movie without my back hurting. Do yourself a favor and pay a little more for a couch that you will actually like. 2
UncomfortableBenjaminThis sofa feels more like a park bench. Cushions are way too firm and have no give. I bought another Kivik in 2019 and it was incredibly comfortable. What has Ikea done to ruin the comfort of this sofa?1
Built like a TANK!KathrynWe bought these in 2017 when our kids were still pretty young thinking “these are cheap and we’ll get us through the kid years.” And now I won’t get rid of them. These are built like a Mac truck . Super durable, comfortable, and you can’t beat the ability to replace the covers. My family is very tall so we did add 5 inch legs to the bottom which was really helpful. I like these so much, that I’m considering buying the sectional add-on. I am also considering getting upgraded covers now. I’m so Excited I bought these.5
UncomfortablePoraneeI bought this sectional sofa 4 years ago because I tried sitting in iKea showroom and it was so comfy. Now, 4 years passed, and my sofa still hard and uncomforable. Cannot even laying on more than 30 mins cause of backpain. 2
